story_clusters.headline: Riksbank signals rate path uncertainty as banks raise mortgage rates ahead of central bank
story_clusters.summary: Swedish commercial banks raised variable mortgage rates in advance of Riksbank action, while Riksbank deputy governors Per Jansson and Aino Bunge signalled the policy rate could move in either direction amid Middle East war-driven energy inflation uncertainty. Analyst forecasts shifted from rate cuts to pricing in multiple hikes during 2026, and SBAB data showed a record share of new customers fixing their mortgage rates in March.
